title: Walking in Solitary Meditation (Iaid Jar Marwei)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Iaid jar marwei ha ki lynti lum,
Haba ka lyer ka pyngngad ka beh;
Nga pyrkhat ia ka jingim ba lyngkot,
Bad ia ka hok ba dei ban bat skhem.

Ki syntiew ki phuh ki iap noh ha madan,
Ki sngi ki leit noh kum ka lyer ba stet;
Hynrei ka kam ba bha ba la leh ha pyrthei,
Kan sah kum u mawbynna ba skhem.
lyrics_english:
Walking alone along quiet mountain tracks,
Where the crisp highland breeze blows free;
I meditate upon the briefness of mortal life,
And the unshakeable truth we must uphold.

The blossoms bloom and wither upon the grass,
The days flit by like the fleeting wind;
Yet the noble deeds wrought on earth,
Shall stand forever like an enduring megalith.
